description: Upgrade the Nexplane backend to a new release version with automatic snapshot, migration, cutover via watchdog, and rollback.

target_version.label: Target Version
target_version.description: Exact semver tag to upgrade to (e.g. 1.4.2)

image_sha256.label: Image SHA-256
image_sha256.description: sha256 digest from release manifest; verified before cutover

changelog_url.label: Changelog URL
changelog_url.description: Link to release notes for the approver

require_approval.label: Require Approval
require_approval.description: Set to 'false' to allow auto-execution (hosted ops path only)

rollback.description: Watchdog restores previous image tag and pg_restore from pre-upgrade snapshot
